Method of Attack: Improper neutralization of escape sequences in the wall command
Injection of arbitrary text onto other users’ terminals
Creation of counterfeit SUDO prompts to steal sensitive information
Modification of clipboard contents on certain terminals

Manipulation of terminal settings via the wall command
Indicators of Compromise: Incorrect password prompt upon entering the correct password
Password appearing in the command history
